# a2a_elixir_sdk v1.0.1 - Table of Contents

Elixir implementation of the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. Exposes ADK agents as A2A-compatible HTTP endpoints and consumes remote A2A agents as local ADK agents.

## Pages

- [A2AEx](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [LLM Usage Rules](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/usage-rules.md)

## Modules

- [A2AEx](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.md): Elixir implementation of the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol.
- [A2AEx.AgentProvider](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.AgentProvider.md): Information about the agent's service provider.
- [A2AEx.DeleteTaskPushConfigParams](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.DeleteTaskPushConfigParams.md): Parameters for deleting a push notification config.
- [A2AEx.GetTaskPushConfigParams](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.GetTaskPushConfigParams.md): Parameters for fetching a specific push notification config.
- [A2AEx.ListTaskPushConfigParams](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.ListTaskPushConfigParams.md): Parameters for listing push notification configs for a task.
- [A2AEx.MessageSendConfig](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.MessageSendConfig.md): Configuration options for a message/send or message/stream request.
- [A2AEx.TCK.Executor](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TCK.Executor.md): Custom AgentExecutor for A2A TCK compliance testing.

- Core Types
  - [A2AEx.AgentCapabilities](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.AgentCapabilities.md): Optional capabilities supported by an agent.
  - [A2AEx.AgentCard](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.AgentCard.md): A self-describing manifest for an agent. Provides essential metadata including
the agent's identity, capabilities, skills, and supported communication methods.

  - [A2AEx.AgentSkill](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.AgentSkill.md): A distinct capability or function that an agent can perform.
  - [A2AEx.Artifact](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Artifact.md): A file, data structure, or other resource generated by an agent during a task.

  - [A2AEx.DataPart](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.DataPart.md): A structured data segment (e.g., JSON) within a message or artifact.

  - [A2AEx.Error](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Error.md): A2A protocol error definitions.
  - [A2AEx.Event](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Event.md): Union type for A2A events that can be sent over streaming connections.

  - [A2AEx.FileBytes](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.FileBytes.md): File content provided as a base64-encoded string.

  - [A2AEx.FilePart](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.FilePart.md): A file segment within a message or artifact.
The file content can be provided either as base64 bytes or as a URI.

  - [A2AEx.FileURI](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.FileURI.md): File content located at a URI.

  - [A2AEx.Message](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Message.md): A single message in the conversation between a user and an agent.

  - [A2AEx.Part](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Part.md): Union type for message/artifact content parts.
  - [A2AEx.Task](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Task.md): A single, stateful operation or conversation between a client and an agent.

  - [A2AEx.TaskArtifactUpdateEvent](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TaskArtifactUpdateEvent.md): Event sent by the agent to notify the client that an artifact has been generated or updated.

  - [A2AEx.TaskState](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TaskState.md): Possible states of an A2A task.

  - [A2AEx.TaskStatus](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TaskStatus.md): The status of a task at a specific point in time.

  - [A2AEx.TaskStatusUpdateEvent](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TaskStatusUpdateEvent.md): Event sent by the agent to notify the client of a change in a task's status.

  - [A2AEx.TextPart](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TextPart.md): A text segment within a message or artifact.

- JSON-RPC
  - [A2AEx.JSONRPC](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.JSONRPC.md): JSON-RPC 2.0 encode/decode layer for the A2A protocol.
  - [A2AEx.MessageSendParams](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.MessageSendParams.md): Parameters for a request to send a message to an agent.
  - [A2AEx.PushAuthInfo](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.PushAuthInfo.md): Authentication details for a push notification endpoint.
  - [A2AEx.PushConfig](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.PushConfig.md): Configuration for push notifications for task updates.
  - [A2AEx.TaskIDParams](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TaskIDParams.md): Parameters containing a task ID, used for simple task operations.
  - [A2AEx.TaskPushConfig](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TaskPushConfig.md): Associates a push notification configuration with a specific task.
  - [A2AEx.TaskQueryParams](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TaskQueryParams.md): Parameters for querying a task, with an option to limit history length.

- Server
  - [A2AEx.AgentExecutor](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.AgentExecutor.md): Behaviour for agent execution.
  - [A2AEx.EventQueue](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.EventQueue.md): Per-task event delivery queue.
  - [A2AEx.PushConfigStore](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.PushConfigStore.md): Behaviour for managing push notification configurations for tasks.
  - [A2AEx.PushConfigStore.InMemory](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.PushConfigStore.InMemory.md): In-memory push config store backed by ETS.
  - [A2AEx.PushSender](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.PushSender.md): Behaviour for sending push notifications about task state changes.

  - [A2AEx.PushSender.HTTP](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.PushSender.HTTP.md): HTTP-based push notification sender using Req.
  - [A2AEx.RequestContext](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.RequestContext.md): Context for an agent execution request.
  - [A2AEx.RequestHandler](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.RequestHandler.md): Business logic for all A2A JSON-RPC methods.
  - [A2AEx.Server](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Server.md): Plug-based HTTP server for the A2A protocol.
  - [A2AEx.TaskStore](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TaskStore.md): Behaviour for persisting A2A tasks.
  - [A2AEx.TaskStore.InMemory](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.TaskStore.InMemory.md): In-memory task store backed by ETS.

- ADK Bridge
  - [A2AEx.ADKExecutor](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.ADKExecutor.md): Bridges ADK agent execution into the A2A protocol.
  - [A2AEx.ADKExecutor.Config](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.ADKExecutor.Config.md): Configuration for the ADK executor bridge.
  - [A2AEx.Converter](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Converter.md): Pure functions for converting between ADK and A2A types.

- Client
  - [A2AEx.Client](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Client.md): HTTP client for consuming remote A2A agents.
  - [A2AEx.Client.SSE](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.Client.SSE.md): Server-Sent Events (SSE) line parser.
  - [A2AEx.RemoteAgent](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.RemoteAgent.md): An ADK agent backed by a remote A2A server.
  - [A2AEx.RemoteAgent.Config](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/A2AEx.RemoteAgent.Config.md): Configuration for creating a remote A2A agent.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix tck.server](https://a2a-elixir-sdk.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Tck.Server.md): Starts the A2A TCK System Under Test (SUT) server.
